rich_text.text: Notifying Russia about your Georgian residence permit

Filing the notice while living abroad is a right, not an obligation. If you got the permit abroad and live there permanently, you don't have to notify the state. But as soon as you return to Russia, you must do it.
How to notify Russia about a residence permit in another country
Russian citizens who obtain a Georgian residence permit
must notify the Russian Ministry of Internal Affairs.

If they are in Russia at that moment, the notice is due within 60 days of receiving the permit. If they are abroad, it is due within 60 days of their first entry into Russia. Otherwise they face a fine or even criminal liability.

title: Notifying Russia about your Georgian residence permit
